prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on your neighborhood, roof type, budget, timeline and whether you’re using insurance. Do you want a shortlist of highly rated Dallas roofers I can research for your ZIP code, or would you prefer tips to vet and compare companies yourself? 

Meanwhile, here’s a quick checklist you can use right away to find the best local contractor:

What to require from any roofer
- Proof of insurance (liability and workers’ comp) and a local business address. Call the insurer to verify.
- Written, itemized estimate (materials, labor, tear-off vs overlay, permit fees, cleanup) and a clear start/completion date.
- Manufacturer certification (GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning) if you want extended warranties.
- Warranty details: material warranty vs workmanship warranty (get workmanship warranty in writing).
- References from recent local jobs and photos of completed work.
- Agreement to pull required permits and to provide lien waivers on final payment.
- A reasonable payment schedule (deposit + progress payments; avoid large up-front sums).

Questions to ask each contractor
- Are you licensed in the city/county where the work will be done? (Note: Texas has no statewide roofing license, but cities/counties may require registration.)
- Can you provide three local references and photos of similar jobs?
- Who will supervise the job and who is the point of contact?
- What materials and underlayment do you recommend and why?
- How do you handle storm damage/insurance claims?
- What is your cleanup process and will you do magnet sweeps for nails?

Red flags
- Door-to-door salespeople offering “special” storm deals.
- Asking for full payment upfront.
- No written estimate, no references, no local address or no proof of insurance.
- Excessively low bids compared with other estimates.

How I can help next
- If you share your ZIP code and any preferences (shingle brand, budget, insurance claim), I can pull together a short list of well-reviewed, pre-vetted roofing companies in Dallas and summarize pros/cons for each.
- Or I can draft an email/phone script for contacting contractors and comparing estimates.

Which would you like me to do?
